description: Core permissions the main window needs. Tauri v2 denies core commands unless granted here, so the menu-event listener requires core:event:allow-listen explicitly. dialog:default covers the native folder picker and message dialog used by config setup. opener:allow-open-url is scoped to http(s) URLs -- covering both the changelog modal's 'view on GitHub' button and links clicked in note previews -- rather than granted for arbitrary URL schemes.
